releases.name: Opi Popi
releases.summary: A short adventure about the quiet hours before sleep. Touch the things in your room in any order you like. What you notice before drowsiness takes over decides how the story ends. Hand-drawn art, voiced by Natsuki Nako, about 30 minutes. Includes a word-shuffling sleep aid tool.

releases.name: My Desktop Cat
releases.summary: Bring a cozy animated cat to your Windows desktop. Care for your companion, play with toys, decorate every screen, unlock new cats and achievements, and play mini games while normal apps stay unobstructed.

releases.name: Rebelote : Belote & Coinche
releases.summary: Rebelote: Belote & Coinche. The great French-speaking card game classic, finally playable online. Form your team, bid, coinche, and try to bring down the opposing side in this turn-based strategy game. Alone against the AI, or with friends.

releases.name: Forest Quest 88
releases.summary: You wake up lost in the woods and just want to get home and go to sleep. A dry, deadpan text adventure on a green CRT screen: type anything or pick from five choices, loot questionable items, and survive cryptid ambushes that only spare you if you packed the right thing. Die in one of 130 ways.

releases.summary: Take charge of a Test nation and run it season after season. Name the squads, award the contracts, appoint your captains — then play out every ball. Tours, world tournaments and a Test championship, while a generation retires under you and the next one comes through.

releases.summary: PokerLeagueGame – PLG#Pokeropolis is the host city of PLG and the first available within the #DTGameWorld.Accompany your game character through his/her poker career; From living homeless in theback alley to balling it out in the suite. PLG is a fun role playing simulationwhere players try to improve the skills of their characters to live a better life and have more fun.In this crazy poker addicted city where even the mayor can be found gambling at the tables,where you decide whether the city's budget will be spent for cleaning the city, free items orpoker freerolls, you are the game.Features:· Playing heads-up vs your friends or other players.· Taking an active part in the city government's decision making process.· Customization.· Ever changing dynamic game world.· Direct player interaction with the game developers.

releases.name: CADRE: Centralized Administration, Data & Reporting Environment
releases.summary: Destroy as many bubbles as possible to move to the next level. Select group of 2 or more same colored bubbles and they will disappear adding point to you. Number of point for each removed bubble depends on number of bubbles in the removed group. To move to the next level you need to remove bubbles from the board, each next level you should remove more bubbles then before.You will get more points for group of 6 cubes, then for 2 groups of 3 cubes.  There are 3 game difficulties: 4, 5 and 6 colours on the board.

releases.name: Emojix
releases.summary: Discover the way right to get the end.Fantastic game where you have to thinking wich way is correct.You will appear at the entrance to the labyrinth. Your task is to find your way to the exit. The exit is marked with a pair of footprints. Through the whole map there are arrows pointing to one or several directions. When you come to a stop you will be prompted to select your direction. You can do that by sliding your finger to desired way or just taping to that direction. In some cases you will be able to choose between 3 directions, so you will have to slide your finger to the right, left or up. There will be times where there is only one way to go. In this case you will not have a choise but to follow through till the next junction. You have to remember where you've been, and what direction leads where to get to the exit.All you have to do is carefully plan your route. You can see the whole map, but your possible directions are marked by the arrows on the ground.-Slide your finger or just tap the screen to which side you want to go.If you want a game like pacman,this is your App

releases.name: Conjurariun
releases.summary: "One touch Drawing" is a simple yet very addictive puzzle game. Try to enjoy "One touch Drawing" from Ecapyc. Many people have the experience playing this kind of game. The rule is very simple. Draw given unique shapes without raising your finger.(with only "One touch") The only problem is "You cannot draw twice the same line". According to clear stages, new lines and points like below will make it difficult. 1. Line that must be passed twice. 2. One directional line. 3. Warp point. 4. Direction trigger. 5. Way trigger.
